title: Measures to Manage Price Volatility of Liquefied Natural Gas
what_it_is: Measures to Manage Price Volatility of Liquefied Natural Gas

sections.label: Singapore GasCo natural gas procurement
sections.summary: GasCo, a Government-owned entity set up in April, centralises natural gas procurement and builds a diversified supply portfolio while avoiding sanctioned entities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The Singapore GasCo is a Government-owned entity that was established in April this year to centralise the procurement of natural gas for the power sector in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: GasCo will construct and maintain a diversified and resilient gas supply portfolio to enhance gas security and mitigate gas price volatility.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: In addition, GasCo will put in place systems and processes to ensure that it does not procure natural gas from sanctioned entities or sanctioned jurisdictions.

sections.label: Standby LNG facility buffer
sections.summary: A standby LNG facility was set up in 2022 as a buffer for extreme price volatilities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As far as the buffer for extreme price volatilities, in 2022, we set up a standby LNG facility.

sections.label: Second LNG terminal construction
sections.summary: A second LNG terminal is committed and under construction, on track for completion between 2028 and 2030, adding 50% throughput and storage.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: To the Member's point about the whether we are increasing our SLNG terminal.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We have, indeed, gone on, we have committed to constructing a second LNG terminal.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Just about a week and a half ago, the steel-cutting ceremony has started.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We are on track to complete the terminal between 2028 and 2030.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: So, once that is done, we would have another 50% increase; not just in throughput, but also in storage, building up our SLNG capabilities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: As far as tariffs is concerned, it is spread across all the different sectors and the prices, like I said, because of our very diversified portfolio that we will be starting from 2026 onwards, we believe that we will be able to manage the volatility in terms of pricing.
